newsitem.title: PERU: Seven die as Peru's army clashes with Shining Path.
newsitem.headline: Seven die as Peru's army clashes with Shining Path.

text.p: Two soldiers and five guerrillas died in a battle between an army patrol and Maoist Shining Path rebels in Peru's isolated jungle highlands, the Defence Ministry said on Thursday.

The army confiscated a rifle, 20 hand grenades and false identity cards after the clash on Tuesday in the Pampahuasi region, a Shining Path's stronghold 140 miles (230 km) southeast of Lima, the ministry said in a statement.
The battle came a day after Shining Path guerrillas killed a civilian in a night raid on the village of Machente. The army repelled that rebel attack, according to the statement.

Clashes with Shining Path in the region have increased since Peru began a huge operation in May to cut off supplies to the group's ailing leader, Oscar Ramirez, who is believed to be hiding out in the rugged highland zone of Vizcatan.
